title: Maximum Requests Without Violating the Limit
summary: Given a 2D integer array of user requests at specific times, and integers k and window, determine the maximum number of requests that can remain without any user making more than k requests in any interval of length window.
statement: Given a 2D integer array of user requests at specific times, and integers k and window, determine the maximum number of requests that can remain without any user making more than k requests in any interval of length window.
constraints: Each request is [user,time], k is positive, and window is nonnegative.
For one user, no k+1 retained requests may have latest time minus earliest time at most window.
Delete as few requests as possible and return the maximum retained total.
hints: Users are independent, so optimize each user’s sorted timeline separately.
Keep a deque of accepted times still within window of the current request.
Accept when fewer than k remain in that deque; otherwise reject the current, latest request.
When a window is full, keeping earlier requests expires no later than keeping the current one, so rejecting the current request is an optimal greedy exchange.

tests.explanation: Each user’s requests are more than four time units apart, so all four remain.
The two same-user requests lie within the window, so only one can remain.
